counterfactual_missing_items: clear indication of epicardial accessory pathway as primary cause
decisive_items: low-voltage scar at the prior mitral isthmus line
postpacing interval more than 20 ms longer than the cycle length when pacing adjacent to the mitral isthmus scar
counterclockwise propagation around the mitral annulus and left atrial appendage, interrupted by a low-voltage scar at the prior mitral isthmus line
response.rationale: R5 is the most likely diagnosis due to the presence of a scar and pacing findings suggesting a tachycardia related to the scar, while R1 is a close runner-up due to the electroanatomic activation map demonstrating counterclockwise propagation around the mitral annulus and left atrial appendage.

rejected.why: Atrial fibrillation is less likely due to the organized atrial activity and presence of a scar.
Epicardial accessory pathway is a possible contributor but not the primary cause.
Mitral Isthmus-Dependent Atrial Flutter, counterclockwise is a more specific type of R1 and does not provide additional diagnostic value.
